verdict.rationale: Headless or CI-driven filing is a fair question for an online government business-registry service, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents interactive browser-based e-filing (an HTML5 web application with online forms, card payments and typed signatures). It shows no API, CLI, bulk interface or documented way to run filings or lookups headlessly or in a CI pipeline.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
